spans.s:
कुगणिन् कुगणिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. 1. कु + गण),
belonging to an evil set of people.

कुगो कु-गो, औस्, m. (see 1. कु), a miserable
or weak bull.

कुग्रह कु-ग्रह, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), an un-
propitious planet; (five are reckoned by some, viz.
Maṅgala, Ravi, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu.)

कुग्राम कु-ग्राम, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a petty
village without a Rājā, an Agnihotrin, a physician, a
rich man, or a river.
